No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this session we help school students choose relevant degrees and subject combinations.

It can be booked by one person or by a class. A short form before the session lets the mentor prepare for you.

What it covers

  • Interest mapping
  • Undergraduate choice
  • Next steps

How the time is spent

  1. Interest mapping 18 min

    History, science, art, fieldwork, languages.

    You: questionnaire

  2. Undergraduate choice 37 min

    Degree routes, costs and admission rules.

    You: choice matrix

  3. Next steps 20 min

    Reading plan, campus shortlists and skill-building.

    You: 12-month starter map

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Diagnose participant goals and constraints based on a pre-session questionnaire.
  • Help school students choose relevant degrees and subject combinations.
  • Leave with personalised recommendations and follow-up actions linked to verified sources.

You take away

A personal action plan with dates and checked sources.
